what: Bairagis and Gusains in Kulu live like peasants with wives and children, cultivating rent-free land around a thakur idol; they have dropped the character of sadhu and the name has become a caste name; ancestors came from the plains as sadhus and gained influence with the Rajas
quote: All these Bairigis and Gusains have quite dropped the character of sddhu : the name has become in fact a caste name.

what: Rent-free grants to Bairagis in the names of thakur idols, made by Rajas Jagat Singh and Man Singh; endowment lands virtually the property of the Bairagi, Gusain or Brahman family; some have sold land; present Bairagis mostly descendants of Kulu Brahmans or Kanets
